paite: Amoz tapa Isai in Judah kumpipa Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz leh Hezekiahte vaihawm lai a, Judah leh Jerusalem tungtang thu a kilakna amuh thu.
heading: Pathian In Amite Ataihilh
english: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

paite: "Vante aw, ngaikhia unla, lei aw, bildoh in, TOUPA'N thu agen hi: Tapate ka khoi a, ka khangliansak a, himahleh ka tung ah ahel uhi.
english: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children and they have rebelled against me.

paite: Bawngtal in aneitu athei a, sabiltung in leng apu anpiakna athei; Israelte'n ahihleh athei kei uh, ka mite'n angaihtuah kei uh," chi in.
english: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know. My people don’t consider.”

paite: Ah! Nam gilou thulimlouhna gikpi po mite, thil hoih lou hihte, gamtat hoihloupi a gamtate ahi ua; TOUPA apaisan ua, Israelte Mi Siangthou amusit ua, kihihtuam in anungtolhta uh.
english: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken Yahweh. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.

paite: Bang achia hel semsem a, vuak a om lailai na hi ua oi? Lutang apum in achi ana a, lungtang leng apum in agimta.
english: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

paite: Khepek nuai a kipan lutang pha in dam lai himhim a-om kei; chikeh, vuak sidup ek, meima naila ngen ahi; huaite lah amekbing kei ua, tuam leng atuam sam kei ua, sathau leng anuh kei uhi.
english: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it, but wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, bandaged, or soothed with oil.

paite: Na gam uh loih in a-om khinta; na khuate uh mei in akang khinta; na gam uh gamdang mite'n na mitmuh un anei khin ua, gamdang mite hihsiat bang in ase khinta hi.
english: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

paite: Zion tanu grephuan a buk bang leh tangmai huan a buk bang leh khopi umbichilh bang in loih in a-omta hi.
english: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N khosuaksun tawmchik hon na sitsak lou hileh Sodom bang in i om khin ding ua, Gomorrah bang in i om khinta ding uhi.
english: Unless Yahweh of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom. We would have been like Gomorrah.

paite: Sodom vaihawmte aw, TOUPA thu za un; Gomorrah mite aw, i Pathian dan thu ah bildoh un.
english: Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

paite: TOUPA'N, "Huai zahzah a na kithoihna uh kei a dia bang ahia athamatna om? Belamtal halmang alatte leh gan vak thaute thau in ahon nimta; bawngtalte leh belamnoute leh kelpate sisan ah leng ka kipak kei, achi hi.
english: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says Yahweh. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.

paite: Ka ma a kilak ding a na hong pai un, ka huangsung intual sik ding kua'n ahon phut a?
english: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts?

paite: Thilpiak bangmah loute hon tawi nawn kei un; banghiam gimlim kei a ding in thilkihhuaipi ahi; kha thakte, Sabbathte, khawmpite na kichialkhawmte mawkmawk uh ka iplah mahmah; kikhopna thupitak leng thulimlouhna ahi.
english: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me. New moons, Sabbaths, and convocations— I can’t stand evil assemblies.

paite: Na kha thakte uleh hunbi nei a na ankuangluinate uh ka lungsim in ahua hi; kei a ding in tunggikna ahi; ka thuak chimta hi.
english: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.

paite: "Huchi in na khut uh na zak chiang un leng ka mit ka hon humsan dia; ahi, tamveipi na thum chiang un leng ka ngaikhe kei ding; na khutte uh lah sisan in adim ngal a.
english: When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.

paite: Kisil unla, kihihsiang un; ka mitmuh phak louh ding in na thilhih giloute uh koihmang unla; gilou hih tawpta un.
english: Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.

paite: Thil hoih hih kisinta unla; vaihawmna diktat zong un, nuaisiahna thuakte panpih unla, pa neiloute vai hawmsak unla, meithai thu gensak un," achi hi.
english: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”

paite: TOUPA'N, "Hong pai un, ngaihtuah khawm dih ve ni! Na khelhnate uh san-au bang in om mahleh, vuk bang in angou ding; sandup bang in san khin mahleh belam mul bang in a-om ding.
english: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

paite: Gennoptak leh thumang a na om uleh, na gam thil hoihte uh na ne ding uh.
english: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;

paite: Himahleh na ut kei ua na hel uleh bel, namsau nek khit in na om ding uh; TOUPA kam in huai agenta hi," achi hi.
english: but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for Yahweh’s mouth has spoken it.”

paite: Bangchidan ahia khopi muanhuaitak kizuak ahong suah maimah, vaihawm diktatna a dim nu hisek hi a! Amah ah diktatna a-om sek a, tu'n lah tualthat mite a-om hi!
heading: Khelhhat Khopi
english: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice. Righteousness lodged in her, but now there are murderers.

paite: Na dangka eksia ahong hita, na uain lah tui toh hel ahita.
english: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.

paite: Na miliante mihelhat, gutate lawmte ahi uh; michih in golhna adeih ua, thilpiak adelh nak uhi; pa neiloute ahawmsak sek kei ua, meithaite makhua khualna leng akiang uh atung ngei sam kei hi.
english: Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes and follows after rewards. They don’t defend the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come to them.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA, Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israelte Mihat in hichi in achi! "Aw le! Hon doute tung ah ka hehna ka tangtungsak dia, ka melmate tung ah phu ka la ding.
english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: “Ah, I will get relief from my adversaries, and avenge myself on my enemies.

paite: Huchi in na tung ah ka khut ka kha ding a, na eksia siang sipsip in ka hihmang ding, na sikgawm tengteng ka lamang vek ding.
english: I will turn my hand on you, thoroughly purge away your dross, and will take away all your tin.

paite: Huan na sung a vaihawmtute atung a la-om bang un ka omsak nawn ding a, na sung a lemthei mite amasapen a a-om bang un ka omsak lai ding hi. Huai khit chiang in, diktatna khopi, khopi muanhuai, ahon chi ding uhi,” achi hi.
english: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called ‘The city of righteousness, a faithful town.’

paite: "Zion vaihawmna diktat a hotkhiak ahita ding a, asung a mi piangthak nawnte leng diktatna a hotkhiak ahi ding uhi.
english: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.

paite: Himahleh mihelte leh mikhialte hihsiatna akituak in a-om ding a, TOUPA paisan mite leng hihman in a-om ding uhi.
english: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake Yahweh shall be consumed.

paite: "Na tosaw deih mahmahte uh azumpihta ding ua, na huan telte uh ziak in zaktatak in na om ding uhi.
english: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.

paite: Tosaw nah vuaite leh huan tui mu lou bang phet na hi ding hi.
english: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.

paite: Huchi in mihattak ziza zial bang ahita ding a, anasep mei-ek bang ahi ding; huchi in akang tuaktuak ding ua; kuamah in aphelh kei ding uh," chi in.
english: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”
